description: This file declares the ServiceContext class within the rialto::servermanager::service namespace. The class implements the IServiceContext interface and manages session server application and IPC controller components, providing a constructor for initialization and a getter method for the session server app manager.

classes.name: ServiceContext
classes.description: Implements IServiceContext, manages session server application and IPC controller components, and provides initialization via constructor.

methods.name: ServiceContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ServiceContext with observer, environment variables, session server path, startup timeout, health check interval, and socket permissions.

methods.name: getSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Returns a reference to the session server application manager.
